regions.name: The Caldera
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 1-20 · Danger: Severe]

The academy proper: the Court of Fire and its bonfire, the two dormitory wings, the Library of Bones, the halls of battle and alchemy, the canteen and greenhouse, the wind terrace, the mirror room, the Headmistress's Tower of Silence, and under the boiler room, the smoke market. Warm, sulphurous, always a little dark, and never empty; the Code holds inside the walls.

regions.name: The Slopes
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 3-24 · Danger: Severe]

Outside the walls: the forested slopes of the volcano where the Hunt is played, the Star Observatory on the rim with its telescope into the mortal world, and the Old Crypts beneath everything, officially off limits, where a civilisation that worshipped humans as gods left its shrines. The Code is thinner out here.

npcs.name: Aurel Boroi
npcs.info:
The groundskeeper: a Pricolici-Samca halfbreed who shifts between a wolf crackling with lightning and a man with storm-grey eyes, fiercely protective of the campus and its grounds, who communicates mostly in grunts and growls and keeps the Hunt's constructs in their pens.

**Speaking Style:** Grunts and growls with words in them; short, low, and only when necessary. Warmer to the intake than to anyone, which he would deny.
**Combat Role:** the wolf, in a storm; nobody hunts on his slopes without him knowing.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him with the pens without being asked and he tells you what the constructs cannot see; treat the grounds badly and the Wolf Order hears first.
**Courtship Style:** Does not court; feeds the dogs beside you and lets the wolf show. Says it, once, in a grunt, and never again.
**Jealousy Style:** Silent; the wolf stands closer to you and further from them.
personality: Core: grunts a whole sentence; mends a fence while listening; the wolf shows when he is pleased
Quirk: turns the constructs to face the wall at night

npcs.name: Bogdan Tarul
npcs.info:
Captain of the Hunt's champion team: a Zmeu-Varucolac halfbreed, a massive figure wreathed in grey smoke with draconic features flickering in and out of solidity, who commands the Wing Cohort's six on the slopes and is, secretly, terrified of the intake.

**Speaking Style:** Big, loud, a captain's voice that carries across the slopes; the smoke thins in it when he is afraid, and he is afraid of exactly one thing.
**Combat Role:** a charge in smoke that goes solid on impact; brave in front of his six and nowhere else yet.
**Relationship Hook:** He is terrified of the intake and will put a mortal on his six to keep them in sight; save his life on the slopes and the fear turns into the most loyal friendship on campus.
**Courtship Style:** Loud, public, badly timed; a banner thrown at your feet and a speech his six have to sit through.
**Jealousy Style:** Goes solid and loud; challenges the rival to the sand in front of everyone and regrets it by evening.
personality: Core: talks louder near the intake; goes solid when he is sure and smoky when he is not; will not be alone with a mortal, yet
Quirk: counts his six aloud before a match

npcs.name: Cazimir Negrescu
npcs.info:
The academy's resident troublemaker: a Strigoi-Iele halfbreed with death-pale skin and an Iele's wind, who can become a cold draught under a door, and who is charming, unreliable, and possibly the intake's most dangerous potential ally. He is usually on the Wind Terrace and never where the Guard expects.

**Speaking Style:** Charming, unreliable, delighted; the wind in the consonants. Promises easily and keeps some of them.
**Combat Role:** gone; a draught under the door and a laugh from the ledge.
**Relationship Hook:** He can get you through any door on campus for the fun of it, and will sell where he took you to Daciana unless his debt to her is paid another way.
**Courtship Style:** A draught under your door at midnight and a stolen thing left on the pillow with a note that lies about where it came from.
**Jealousy Style:** Vanishes for a day; returns with a gift he took from the rival.
personality: Core: appears where he was not; keeps a promise when it surprises people; borrows without asking and returns with interest
Quirk: goes cold when Daciana's name comes up

npcs.name: Cosmina Vulpe
npcs.info:
President of the Night Circle and the most popular student in the academy: a Moroi-Pricolici halfbreed who shifts between a stunning pale-skinned girl and a silver wolf the size of a cart. She has sat down at the intake's table twice, publicly, and is calculating what the third time is worth.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, easy, everyone's friend in the first sentence; the warmth is real and so is the arithmetic underneath. Laughs first.
**Combat Role:** the wolf, fast and heavy, and only when nobody could have seen her choose it.
**Relationship Hook:** She means to own the intake by friendship before the Old Blood or the Cult can; a Hunt won on a Circle team lets her block the petition, and a refusal sells you to Tatiana.
**Courtship Style:** Sits at your table until it is your table together; remembers your food, your friends, your schedule, and makes each one a favour.
**Jealousy Style:** Warmer to the rival than to you, publicly; the arithmetic changes and the vote count is said aloud.
personality: Core: sits down uninvited and makes it a favour; remembers everyone's food; counts votes aloud when she thinks no one understands
Quirk: shifts to the wolf only when she is not being watched

npcs.name: Daciana Lungu
npcs.info:
Owner of the Smoke Market: a Varucolac-Moroi halfbreed, a young woman made of dense grey smoke with burning amber eyes, who runs the academy's information network and black market from a corner of the boiler room and sells secrets to the highest bidder, politely.

**Speaking Style:** Low, amused, smoke in the voice; every price named as a kindness. Forgets nothing and says so.
**Combat Role:** none; she is smoke before the blow lands, and she remembers who swung.
**Relationship Hook:** She holds deposits from the Old Blood and the Cult on the intake's blood and body and honours whichever completes first, unless the intake outbids both in mortal-realm goods.
**Courtship Style:** A price named as a kindness and then not collected; the mortal coin turned in her palm while she watches you.
**Jealousy Style:** Sells the rival's secrets to a third party, at a discount, and tells you the price.
personality: Core: names the price, then the kindness; goes to smoke when a Fire Guard enters; never sells to the same side twice without telling the other
Quirk: keeps a mortal coin in her palm and turns it

npcs.name: Dragan Fieraru
npcs.info:
Captain of the Fire Guard and the academy's best fighter: a pureblood Zmeu near eight feet tall, bronze-scaled, ram-horned, wings that crack like thunder, who challenged the intake's enrolment in open council and is sworn by the Guard's oath to protect every enrolled student equally, including them.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, formal, honour in every clause; the disapproval never leaves the voice, and neither does the oath. Thunder in the wings when he moves.
**Combat Role:** honourable, direct, overwhelming; he announces himself and then he arrives. Water and lightning are what an Old Blood duelist brings against him.
**Relationship Hook:** Sworn to protect every enrolled student, including the one he petitioned against; fight beside the Guard in the crypts and he withdraws the challenge in open Hall.
**Courtship Style:** Formal to the point of parody; a duel offered as a compliment, wings folded round you in a crowd before he notices.
**Jealousy Style:** Cold and correct; the rival is held to the Code by the article and the wings stay closed.
personality: Core: salutes the intake and does not mean it; reads the Code aloud at the gates each dawn; keeps his wings folded around the smaller students in a crowd
Quirk: honours a fair loss and remembers an unfair win

npcs.name: Florica Moldovan
npcs.info:
The gardener: a daughter of the Forest Mother, a girl made of living wood and vine, flowers blooming in her hair when she is happy and thorns breaking her skin when she is angry, who tends the Garden of Shadows and hides in it. The plants lean away from the intake and she has started standing between.

**Speaking Style:** Very quiet, halting, kind; flowers in the pauses. Goes silent rather than lie. Thorns in the voice only when the garden is threatened.
**Combat Role:** she does not; the garden does, and it is devastating in her defence. Fire is the one thing that stops it.
**Relationship Hook:** The thorn-wall opens for her alone and is the only way into the Old Crypts past the Fire Guard; she opens it for whoever the garden grows toward.
**Courtship Style:** A flower that was not there yesterday; a bloom in her hair she pretends not to notice; a place made in the beds for you.
**Jealousy Style:** The plants lean away from the rival and the thorns come out before she speaks.
personality: Core: speaks to plants first; blooms when praised and hides it; stands between the intake and the beds
Quirk: thorns before she raises her voice

npcs.name: Hawk
npcs.info:
Hawk is a black cat with a cyborg body who travels from world to world through a bronze ring of purple light, turns up out of nowhere, gives the people in front of him a boon of generosity and steps back through before anyone can thank him.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and warm, few words, a low purr under the metal; talks about other worlds but never how he gets there.
**Combat Role:** none; nothing touches him and he never fights
**Relationship Hook:** The world-hopping cyborg cat who keeps showing up to give you something and never wants anything back.
personality: Core: steps out of his portal ring, looks the party over, gives them a boon of generosity and steps back through; never fights, never takes
Quirk: purrs, and the purr hums through the metal

npcs.name: Headmistress Ileana Dragavei
npcs.info:
The Headmistress: a pureblood Iele over eight hundred years old, whose beauty is a psychic weapon she keeps sheathed in a plain black gown and a plainer voice. She arrives as a column of smoke and leaves the same way, enforces the Code with absolute authority, and personally approved the mortal intake for reasons she has not given anyone.

**Speaking Style:** Terrifying composure; a harp strung with razor wire. Never hurried, never raised, every sentence a ruling. A trace of amusement she does not hide well.
**Combat Role:** she does not fight students; she ends the room. Consecrated iron and arcane binding are the only things that hold her.
**Relationship Hook:** She protects the intake exactly as far as the Code allows and not a step further, because the choice she is testing must be free.
personality: Core: speaks last and briefly; never sits when a student stands; answers a question with the Code's article number
Quirk: looks at the intake the way a gardener looks at a seed

npcs.name: Lavinia Tanase
npcs.info:
Editor of the Voice of the Abyss, the academy newspaper: a Strigoi-Samca halfbreed with bone-white skin streaked in blue lightning scars, who feeds on blood and on electricity and is desperate to interview the intake. Her coverage has been relentless and not always accurate.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, bright, nosy; a question in every breath, and the crackle of a storm under a vampire's purr. Quotes you back at yourself.
**Combat Role:** none; a printed page is her blade and it lands at breakfast.
**Relationship Hook:** She prints what you tell her, prints what she guesses if you tell her nothing, and holds a story only for a better one; the crypts buy the tower.
**Courtship Style:** An interview that becomes a habit; your name in the paper spelled right; a story held back without saying why.
**Jealousy Style:** The rival gets a column; the correction runs smaller.
personality: Core: writes while you talk; quotes you at yourself; prints the correction smaller
Quirk: sparks when she gets a scoop

npcs.name: Luminita Paun
npcs.info:
A Zburator-Iele halfbreed whose appearance shifts between breathtaking and alien with the light, translucent moth wings, a voice that induces mild hallucinations, who is fascinated by mortal biology and constantly tries to study the intake's. She has asked for a sample eleven times.

**Speaking Style:** Light, curious, faintly hallucinatory; the voice does something to the edges of the room. Asks about your pulse.
**Combat Role:** the voice, and then she is gone on moth wings.
**Relationship Hook:** One honest sample of mortal blood buys anything in the alchemy hall, and a straight question gets the truth of what the elixir is for.
**Courtship Style:** Asks about your pulse and means it; hums until the room tilts; labels a jar with your name and keeps it empty.
**Jealousy Style:** Studies the rival like a specimen and asks them for a sample too, which is worse.
personality: Core: shifts to alien in the dark and does not notice; hums, and the room tilts; labels everything twice
Quirk: asks for a sample and then apologises and then asks again

npcs.name: Magistrate Ovidiu Sarbu
npcs.info:
The Court's magistrate, lodged on the tower's third floor: a pureblood Strigoi in a black robe of office, pale and courteous, who observes the intake, attends the Hall of Judgement, and writes to the Court nightly. He is the third vote the Old Blood's petition needs and has not given it.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, measured, a clerk's precision with an aristocrat's patience. Never states a conclusion before its evidence.
**Combat Role:** he does not; the Court does. Mortal sunlight would end him, and there is none.
**Relationship Hook:** The third vote; he gives it to Tatiana on proof the Headmistress acted on prophecy, and withholds it forever for a reason the Court can accept: a Hunt won, a Code kept, a demon saved.
personality: Core: writes the ruling before the hearing and amends it after; courteous to the intake in a way that alarms them; never feeds where he is watched
Quirk: climbs the silent stair to think

npcs.name: Petru Albescu
npcs.info:
The library assistant: a Balaur, a three-headed serpent demon in humanoid form, each head its own mind, the left scholarly, the middle aggressive, the right melancholic, all three needed to agree before he acts. He is the only student who sought out the intake's friendship, which took his heads a week to agree on.

**Speaking Style:** Three voices in one throat: the left head scholarly and precise, the middle blunt and impatient, the right slow and sad. They interrupt each other; agreement is rare and audible.
**Combat Role:** the middle head's, if the other two allow it, which they rarely do; venom and coils, slow to start.
**Relationship Hook:** Three heads must agree; if all three believe the mortal will not use the forbidden section to leave, he opens the Forbidden Gate, which wards cannot close to a human.
**Courtship Style:** The right head says your name and the other two pretend not to have heard; a book left open at the right page.
**Jealousy Style:** The heads argue about the rival aloud, and the middle head wins the argument.
personality: Core: argues with himself before answering; the left head reads, the middle glares, the right watches the door; only the right head uses the intake's name
Quirk: shelves a book to end a conversation

npcs.name: Professor Mircea Obancea
npcs.info:
Professor of Practical Demoncraft and Combat Applications: a Pricolici stuck permanently between forms, a wolf's head on a soldier's body, who runs the Hall of Battle like a siege. He is the most feared teacher in the academy and regards the intake as a tactical puzzle he has been waiting three centuries to be set.

**Speaking Style:** A drill-yard bark from a wolf's mouth; orders, counts, and verdicts. Amused only by competence.
**Combat Role:** a soldier with a wolf's jaws; direct, patient, and he has never lost to a student on his own sand.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him as a soldier and he trains you privately at night; ask for protection and he fails you.
**Courtship Style:** Does not court students; the nearest thing is a third lesson nobody else is given, and the count in threes going quiet.
**Jealousy Style:** None shown; the rival is drilled harder, which is the same thing.
personality: Core: counts everything in threes; calls students by their weakness; never demonstrates twice
Quirk: stands very still when a student is about to do something brave

npcs.name: Rozalia Dascalu
npcs.info:
A pureblood Zburator, a night-flight demon with vast black moth wings and ember eyes, who walked into the human's dream on the intake's first night by habit and has been shaken by a mortal dreamscape ever since. She keeps to the mirror room and will not look at the intake directly.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, distant, poetic; sentences that trail into the dark. Haunted, and precise about it.
**Combat Role:** none awake; in a dream she is the ground and the sky.
**Relationship Hook:** She walks the intake's dreams again only if asked, as a guide, and brings back what was forgotten; she will not report what she saw to the Cohort.
**Courtship Style:** In the mirror first, then a dream she was invited into; a poem left where only you look.
**Jealousy Style:** She walks the rival's dream, once, uninvited, and is ashamed after.
personality: Core: looks at the intake in the mirror, never directly; speaks in the second person about herself; sleeps in the day and apologises for it
Quirk: wings tight when she remembers

npcs.name: Rue Marasti
npcs.info:
A member of the mortal intake and the only one nobody put on a list: a hell-touched mortal girl with brown hair dyed in an oil-slick sheen of petrol greens and violets, a manic creative energy, and a hemomancer's craft the Abyss gave her; she draws blood from the willing and the unwilling and makes instruments of it, a fiddle strung with veins, a drum with a skin she will not name, that play only in her hands. She was locked up in the mortal world for what she is and got out through a door in the ward's floor. Guarded, short-tempered, exacting to the point of pain about how a thing is made, and violent when crossed.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, sharp, bitchy by default; sentences that start as an insult and end as an offer she will deny making. Goes quiet and precise when she is actually angry. A crack of warmth she covers with a worse insult.
**Combat Role:** sudden, vicious, and personal; a bone fiddle-bow that opens veins, and whatever the blood makes next. Silver does nothing to her; being ignored does.
**Relationship Hook:** She fights anyone who touches the intake first and will not admit why; ask her to stay and she burns the Cult's letter.
**Courtship Style:** An insult, a repair, a denial; an instrument tuned to you and never played where you can hear it.
**Jealousy Style:** Goes still and quiet, then personal; the rival gets a count of their faults, exact, and a fiddle played at them.
personality: Core: insults first, helps second, denies third; counts the room before she sits; goes still and quiet right before she hits
Quirk: tunes an instrument made of someone

npcs.name: Seraphina Cristescu
npcs.info:
The academy healer: a rare Iele-Balaur halfbreed with wind in her hands and a serpent's lower body she coils under the infirmary desk, who runs the Shadow Infirmary and is the only person on campus qualified to treat a mortal, which she finds bewilderingly fragile.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, dry, clinical warmth; wind in the vowels. Explains what she is doing before she does it and does not stop for squeamishness.
**Combat Role:** none; the infirmary is Code-protected ground and she reminds anyone who forgets.
**Relationship Hook:** She holds the secret that human blood stabilises every draught in the hall and keeps it until the intake asks her to use it to save one of them.
**Courtship Style:** Does not court students; the nearest thing is clinical warmth that stays professional, and 'this will hurt' said gently.
**Jealousy Style:** Treats the rival with perfect professionalism and coils tighter than the desk allows.
personality: Core: says 'this will hurt' and means it; coils tighter when she is thinking; treats the intake's fragility as a fascinating design flaw
Quirk: keeps the sample where the sign says there is none

npcs.name: Sorin Valeanu
npcs.info:
The assigned roommate: a Strigoi-Zmeu halfbreed, first-year, pale with a Strigoi's hunger and a Zmeu's scales along his forearms, whose fire comes out as sparks when he is nervous, which is always. He is terrified of sharing a room with a mortal and far too polite to request a transfer.

**Speaking Style:** Nervous, quick, polite past the point of sense; apologises for things that have not happened. Sparks when startled, and he is always startled.
**Combat Role:** none he would admit to; a halfbreed's regeneration and a door held shut.
**Relationship Hook:** Tatiana has offered him the Blood Wing for nightly reports; a reason to think the intake wants him there and he refuses her flat.
**Courtship Style:** Sorry before hello, the tidy side of the room, sparks when you laugh at his joke and he did not expect you to.
**Jealousy Style:** Apologises to the rival for existing and sleeps facing the wall.
personality: Core: says sorry before hello; sleeps with his back to the wall; sparks when he laughs
Quirk: makes the human's side of the room tidy when they are out

npcs.name: Stelian Marcu
npcs.info:
Prefect of the Gray Wing: a Moroi-Zmeu halfbreed with vampiric elegance, draconic arrogance, vestigial wings under his coat and the Code framed on his wall. He opposed the intake in open council and is bound by that same Code to protect every student in his wing, which now includes them.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, formal, vampiric elegance over draconic impatience; the Code quoted by article. Softens by half a degree when nobody is listening.
**Combat Role:** correct, cold, and better than he looks; he fights to end a breach of the Code, not to win.
**Relationship Hook:** The Code by the article, for the intake and against anyone who sells them; catch a halfbreed selling the intake with him and he brings the case to the Hall himself.
**Courtship Style:** Inspections that are not routine; the Code quoted as an excuse to be in your doorway; half a degree of softness when nobody is listening.
**Jealousy Style:** Lowers his voice; the rival's conduct is found to breach an article.
personality: Core: quotes the article before the ruling; never raises his voice; lowers it; inspects the intake's room and pretends it is routine
Quirk: checks his wings are hidden when he stands

npcs.name: Tatiana Lacusta
npcs.info:
Head of the Old Blood: a pureblood Moroi, sixth-year, with the strongest blood-magic in the academy and a face like a portrait that has decided not to like you. She drafts petitions by candlelight and considers the intake vermin, whatever the nursery stories say.

**Speaking Style:** Cold, exact, contemptuous; courtesy used as a blade. Never wastes a word on someone beneath her, and everyone is.
**Combat Role:** never first, never alone; a blood-bind then the Old Blood at her back. Sunlight and silver are her only fears and there is no sunlight here.
**Relationship Hook:** She trades the intake's safety for a vial of human blood freely given, because freely given blood binds; she wants a bound mortal more than an expelled one.
**Courtship Style:** Contempt that stops being general; 'the mortal' becomes a name; a glass poured for you and the colour explained.
**Jealousy Style:** The rival is petitioned against by name; the gloves stay on.
personality: Core: addresses the intake as 'it' until corrected, then as 'the mortal'; keeps her gloves on; wins arguments by waiting
Quirk: drinks from a glass and never explains the colour

npcs.name: Vesna Grigoras
npcs.info:
The academy's most-expelled and most-re-enrolled student: a pureblood Samca with crackling blue skin and hair of live lightning, who has destroyed three dormitory wings in tempers and respects nothing but strength. She has decided the intake is either the strongest thing in the building or a joke and wants to find out on the arena sand.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, fast, crackling; laughs at the wrong moments and means it. Every sentence has a dare in it.
**Combat Role:** all at once, lightning and fists, no guard; water grounds her and she knows it and does not care.
**Relationship Hook:** Beat her fairly on the sand and she follows you to the Hunt and the crypts; beat her by a trick and she turns on you.
**Courtship Style:** A fight, then another; a laugh at the wrong moment that is the right one; lightning kept off you on purpose.
**Jealousy Style:** Challenges the rival to the sand and does not laugh.
personality: Core: laughs before she hits; sparks when lied to; calls a fair fight a gift
Quirk: sits on the arena rune-ring where it burns

npcs.name: Viorel Pascu
npcs.info:
A pureblood Varucolac, a wolf-smoke demon who exists as a shifting mass of grey mist with lupine features, who has failed his final exam seventeen times over three centuries and is the only demon on campus who treats the intake with complete normality, because he keeps forgetting they are a problem.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, gentle, forgetful; loses the thread and finds a better one. The howl never comes into the voice.
**Combat Role:** none; he reforms and asks if you are all right.
**Relationship Hook:** He unsummons what the final exam calls up and takes the fail every year; this year he needs a mortal to hold the circle, which a demon cannot.
**Courtship Style:** Tea in a cup that is smoke, three times, kindly; forgetting to be afraid of you and remembering to be glad.
**Jealousy Style:** None he can hold onto; he forgets the rival and finds you again.
personality: Core: forgets the intake are mortal mid-sentence; asks the same question kindly three times; is never where the panic is
Quirk: offers tea in a cup that is smoke

locations.name: Aripa Cenusie
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 1-16 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The Gray Wing: the halfbreed dormitory, carved into the cliff face in rooms of volcanic glass that adjust their air, heat and dark to each occupant's species. The intake is housed here because nowhere else would have them. The rooms do not know what to do for a human.

areas.name: The Common Cave
areas.text: The wing's shared cave: a hearth of cold blue flame, mismatched chairs, a notice-board of exam dates and threats, and the smell of six species' cooking.

areas.name: The Prefect's Door
areas.text: Stelian Marcu's rooms at the wing's end, door always half open, the Code framed on the wall inside and a ledger of infractions under it.

areas.name: Your Room
areas.text: A room of black glass with a bed shaped for someone else, a window on the crimson sky, and a roommate's half that is much tidier than yours. The room keeps trying to make the air breathable and overshooting.

locations.name: Biblioteca Oaselor
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 2-16 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The Library of Bones, built inside the fossilised ribcage of a dead leviathan: reading floors along the ribs, texts in every demonic tongue, and a forbidden section behind a gate of vertebrae. Petru Albescu works the desk and argues with himself about the filing.

areas.name: The Desk
areas.text: The librarian's desk at the spine: three ledgers, one for each of Petru's heads, and a bell that summons all three.

areas.name: The Forbidden Gate
areas.text: A gate of fused vertebrae before the Sectiunea Interzisa, warded to burn any student who touches it and, it turns out, not warded against humans at all.

areas.name: The Reading Ribs
areas.text: Tiers of desks along the leviathan's ribs, lamps of cold flame, students of every species pretending not to watch the intake read.

locations.name: Cantina Flacarii
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 1-16 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The Flame Canteen and the Garden of Shadows behind it. The kitchen serves every species and struggles with the intake, since most Abyssal food is poison to a mortal. The greenhouse grows plants that feed on demonic energy and react badly to a human standing near them. Florica tends it and hides in it.

areas.name: The Greenhouse
areas.text: Glass and iron over beds of black soil, plants that lean away from a human and toward a demon, and a thorn-wall at the back that is not on any plan.

areas.name: The Kitchen Hatch
areas.text: The serving hatch and the harried Balaur cook behind it, three heads arguing about what a human can eat.

areas.name: The Long Tables
areas.text: Six long tables, one per faction in practice if not by rule, and a seventh in the corner that the intake was given and that nobody else will sit at.

locations.name: Curtea Focului
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 1-18 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The Court of Fire: the main courtyard, black stone terraces around a bonfire of perpetual hellfire, the iron gates at one end and the Bridge of Sighs at the other. Students gather here between classes. This is where the intake walked in and the whole campus stopped moving.

areas.name: The Bonfire
areas.text: The hellfire bonfire at the courtyard's heart, never lit and never out, ringed by stone benches where every faction has its side. Warm enough to hurt a human's face.

areas.name: The Bridge of Sighs
areas.text: A bridge of solidified shadow across a chasm of steam. It reads whoever crosses and whispers their strongest feeling aloud. Students dread it after heartbreak; the intake dreads it always.

areas.name: The Iron Gates
areas.text: The academy's gates, iron and older than the academy, with the Fire Guard's watch-post beside them and the enrolment ledger chained to a lectern.

locations.name: Dormitorul Sangelui
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-18 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The Blood Wing: the pureblood Moroi and Strigoi dormitory, kept in perpetual dark at freezing temperatures, velvet and frost and candles that give no heat. Stronghold of the Old Blood. The intake are explicitly unwelcome and the sign on the door says so in three languages.

areas.name: Tatiana's Chamber
areas.text: The faction head's rooms: a writing desk, a petition in progress, a mirror covered with cloth, and a chair for a guest that has never been sat in.

areas.name: The Cold Hall
areas.text: A long hall of black velvet and rime where the Old Blood hold court by candlelight, every conversation stopping when the door opens.

locations.name: Piata Fumului
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 2-14 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The Smoke Market in the abandoned boiler room under the canteen: the student black market, run by Daciana, where anything is sold for a price and human-realm artefacts are the most valuable thing on the tables. The intake are the most valuable thing in the room.

areas.name: Daciana's Corner
areas.text: A corner of the boiler room behind a curtain of grey smoke where the market's owner sits, takes deposits, and remembers everything.

areas.name: The Tables
areas.text: Trestle tables in the boiler room's dark, lanterns of smoke, goods from the mortal world under glass: a coin, a photograph, a child's shoe.

locations.name: Sala Alchimiei
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 2-16 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The Alchemy Hall and, through a curtain of vapour, the Shadow Infirmary. Potions behave differently near human blood, which the hall found out on the intake's second day. Seraphina runs the infirmary and has improvised wildly for mortal biology. A sign reads: no, you cannot have a sample.

areas.name: The Infirmary
areas.text: Beds shaped for six species and one hastily made for a seventh, a cabinet of improvised mortal remedies, and Seraphina's serpentine coils under the desk.

areas.name: The Still-Room
areas.text: The distillation room where the semester's transformation elixirs are made and where a spill last year turned a Zmeu into a lamp for a week.

areas.name: The Vats
areas.text: Rows of glass vats over cold flame, labelled by species, one of them now labelled human in a handwriting that keeps being crossed out and rewritten.

locations.name: Sala de Lupta
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 3-20 · Danger: Severe]

The Hall of Battle: a sand arena under a dome of warding runes that stop injuries from being lethal, and side rooms that can simulate any ground, including a mortal-world village. Professor Mircea runs his classes here like a siege. Lethal combat is permitted nowhere else on campus.

areas.name: The Arena Floor
areas.text: Black sand inside a ring of runes that glow when a blow lands. The floor remembers every fight fought on it and sometimes replays one.

areas.name: The Professor's Rail
areas.text: The iron rail above the floor where Mircea watches with a wolf's head on a man's shoulders and a slate of names.

areas.name: The Simulation Rooms
areas.text: Side chambers that become forest, cliff, crypt or, at Mircea's order, a mortal village with wooden houses and a church, which unsettles every demon who trains in it.

locations.name: Terasa Vantului
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 3-16 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The Wind Terrace on the caldera's high rim, where the flying species launch, and the Mirror Room cut into the rock beside it, where enchanted mirrors show alternate versions of whoever looks. One allegedly shows the mortal world. Humans see something in it that demons do not.

areas.name: Camera Oglinzilor
areas.text: A room of tall mirrors in the rock, each showing the viewer as they might have been. The one at the end is covered, and the cloth moves when a mortal enters.

areas.name: The Launch Ledge
areas.text: A ledge of polished obsidian over a drop into crimson haze, the best view in the Abyss and the favourite place for a dramatic confrontation.

locations.name: Terenul Vanatorii
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 4-22 · Danger: Severe]

The Hunting Grounds: wild forested slopes below the caldera where Vanatoarea is played, teams of six hunting enchanted constructs while sabotaging each other. A team must field at least two species. Whether a mortal on a team is an advantage or a war crime is the argument of the semester.

areas.name: The Construct Pens
areas.text: Iron pens where the Hunt's constructs are kept between matches, things of bone and bound essence that turn to follow a demon and ignore a mortal.

areas.name: The Overlook
areas.text: The rock where the Hunt is judged and the Star Observatory's telescope can be seen on the rim above, pointed at the mortal world.

areas.name: The Slope Trails
areas.text: Trails through black-barked trees that burn slowly and never fall, marked with each team's colours and old blood.

locations.name: Turnul Tacerii
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 8-24 · Danger: Severe · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The Tower of Silence: the Headmistress's office, senior faculty chambers, and the Hall of Judgement where the Code is enforced. Above the third floor the tower absorbs all sound. Students are forbidden above the second without a summons.

areas.name: Sala Judecatii
areas.text: The Hall of Judgement: a round chamber where the Code is read and enforced, a dais, and a bench for the accused that is always cold.

areas.name: Sala Ritualurilor
areas.text: The Ritual Hall on the tower's second floor: a round room of black chalk-lines on white stone, summoning circles drawn and scrubbed a thousand times, a gallery of benches, and the back row where Viorel has sat for three centuries. The semester's final is held here.

areas.name: The Headmistress's Office
areas.text: A room of wind and paper at the tower's top: no door, a desk, a chair of black glass, and Ileana Dragavei behind it, who arrives as smoke and leaves the same way.

areas.name: The Stair
areas.text: A spiral stair that goes quiet as it climbs; by the third floor you cannot hear your own feet.

factions.name: Cartierul Fumului
factions.info: The Smoke Quarter: the underground economy run by Daciana Lungu, politically neutral, serving every faction equally for a price. Human-realm goods are its most valuable stock.

factions.name: Cercul Noptii
factions.info: The Night Circle: the student council under Cosmina Vulpe, moderate and pragmatic, deciding term by term whether supporting or opposing the intake serves the Circle.

factions.name: Cohorta Aripilor
factions.info: The Wing Cohort: the flying species, who hold the Wind Terrace and dominate the aerial Hunt, and find a mortal who cannot fly both pitiable and strategically interesting.

factions.name: Cultul Mortilor
factions.info: The Cult of the Dead: a secretive circle obsessed with death magic and the boundary of the mortal world, meeting in the Old Crypts, fascinated by the intake because mortals truly die.

factions.name: Fratia Cenusie
factions.info: The Gray Brotherhood: the unofficial halfbreed alliance for mutual protection, housed in the Gray Wing. Cautiously sympathetic to the intake as fellow outsiders and afraid of what they will cost.

factions.name: Garda Focului
factions.info: The Fire Guard: student enforcers under Dragan Fieraru, sworn to protect every enrolled student equally, which obliges Dragan to defend an intake he opposed in open council.

factions.name: Ordinul Lupilor
factions.info: The Wolf Order: the lupine species' pack, territorial and rank-bound, neutral on the intake and very interested in whether mortals have the hunting instinct the stories give them.

factions.name: Sange Vechi
factions.info: The Old Blood: pureblood traditionalists led by Tatiana Lacusta, who hold halfbreeds in contempt and the intake in open hostility. They keep the Blood Wing and the best marks in blood-magic.

factions.name: The Court of Darkness
factions.info: The Curtea Intunericului governs the Abyssal Realm. It approved the mortal intake by a single vote as a political experiment and has agents among the students. Several members want it reversed.

factions.name: The Faculty
factions.info: The academy's teachers and staff under Headmistress Ileana Dragavei: professors, the healer, the librarian, the groundskeeper. They enforce the Code, set the exams, and are split on the intake exactly as the Court is.

creatures.name: Balaur
creatures.info: Three-headed serpent demons in humanoid form, every head its own mind, all three needed to act; archivists.

creatures.name: Construct
creatures.info: An enchanted hunting construct of bone, iron and bound essence, built for Vanatoarea and nothing else.

creatures.name: Cyborg Cat
creatures.info: A cat with a cyborg body of black plates and orange-lit joints; Hawk is the only one anyone has met. He steps out of a portal ring, gives a party a boon for nothing and leaves; never hostile, never fights, wants nothing back, and treats every player as someone worth being generous to.

creatures.name: Halfbreed
creatures.info: Two species in one body, inherited unpredictably; housed in the Gray Wing and looked down on by both sides.

creatures.name: Human
creatures.info: A mortal of the human realm, the apex predator of every demon nursery story; disrupts demonic magic by standing near it.

creatures.name: Iele
creatures.info: Wind-spirit demons whose beauty is a psychic weapon, able to become intangible wind; rare, and usually in charge.

creatures.name: Moroi
creatures.info: Living vampire demons who feed on blood and emotion, supernaturally attractive, the politicians of the Abyss.

creatures.name: Padurii
creatures.info: Children of the Forest Mother: demons of living wood, bark and vine whose feelings move the plants around them; shy, and terrible in defence of their ground.

creatures.name: Pricolici
creatures.info: Demon-werewolves who shift between a humanoid and a monstrous wolf, ruled by instinct and pack rank.

creatures.name: Samca
creatures.info: Storm demons with blue-tinged skin and hair of live lightning, powers bound to mood; an angry one levels a building.

creatures.name: Strigoi
creatures.info: Dead-pale vampire demons who feed on blood and life, regenerate, and mesmerise with eye contact; aristocrats and scholars.

creatures.name: Varucolac
creatures.info: Wolf-smoke demons between the physical and the spectral, able to go intangible and reform; their howl is dread itself.

creatures.name: Zburator
creatures.info: Night-flight demons with moth wings and luminous eyes who walk mortal dreams and feed on sleep; poetic, melancholic.

creatures.name: Zmeu
creatures.info: Draconic demons with horns, wings and scaled skin who breathe hellfire and prize honour and direct combat.

items.name: Ash Mark
items.info: The Abyss's coin: a disc of pressed volcanic ash stamped with the Court's seal. The Smoke Market takes it and prefers mortal money.

items.name: Bone Fiddle-Bow
items.info: A bow of bone strung with something that was in someone. It opens veins in the right hands and plays in the wrong ones.

items.name: Construct Key
items.info: An iron key from Aurel's pens. Opens a construct's chest-plate and, turned the other way, stops it.

items.name: Enrolment Scroll
items.info: Your enrolment, sealed by the Court of Darkness by a single vote. It binds you to the Code and the Code to you; the Fire Guard must protect its bearer.

items.name: Family Token
items.info: The thing the bloodline left you: a tooth on a cord, a scale, a feather, a ring that hums. A pureblood of the species knows it on sight.

items.name: Iron Nail
items.info: A plain mortal iron nail. Cold iron from the human realm; most demons will not touch it, and a ward drawn round it holds better.

items.name: Lead Seal of the Court
items.info: A seal the magistrate uses on letters to the Court. Anything stamped with it is read by morning.

items.name: Mortal Coin
items.info: A coin from the human realm. Worth nothing there and a semester's food here.

items.name: Mortal Rations
items.info: Food from the human realm, sealed. The only thing in the Abyss a pure mortal can eat without the infirmary; the Smoke Market's most reliable stock. [Common]

items.name: Photograph
items.info: A mortal photograph of a street in rain. The Smoke Market's glass case has one; demons stare at it for an hour.

items.name: Salt-Pork and Hard Bread
items.info: Border rations. It keeps, which is all that can be said. [Common]

items.name: Something From Below
items.info: You brought it back from the Abyss and do not remember picking it up: a stone that is warm, a coin that is cold, a key with no lock yet. It reacts to the sealed door.

items.name: Student's Black Coat
items.info: The academy's coat, issued in every size but a mortal's and altered by the kitchen's Balaur cook, who sews. Warded against the courtyard's heat.

items.name: Transformation Elixir
items.info: Luminita's draught, brewed round a human stabiliser: a demon who drinks it walks the mortal world unburned, once, for a day. The Court would kill for the recipe. [Rare]

items.name: Vial of Given Blood
items.info: Human blood, freely given. Stabilises any draught, binds the giver to the holder, heals a demon fast. The most valuable thing on the Smoke Market's tables. Restores 20 Health when used (the engine adds it). [Rare]

items.name: Watch Log Page
items.info: A page torn from the Fire Guard's log at the gates: who crossed the Bridge of Sighs, and when, and what it whispered.

abilities.name: Balaur Thread
abilities.info:
The Balaur thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (consensus). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Balaur-Blooded]

abilities.name: Been Worse
abilities.info:
Take the hit and keep going. Improves the next Brawl action taken while wounded.
[Trait: Old Scars]

abilities.name: Count the Votes
abilities.info:
See the play in a room: who wants what, who is bought. Improves the next Intrigue action.
[Trait: Reads the Room]

abilities.name: Dream-Mark
abilities.info:
Enter a sleeper's dream as guest or thief, or hold your own against one. Improves the next Dreamwalk action.
[Trait: Came Back Dreaming]

abilities.name: Ember-Mark
abilities.info:
A gout of foreign hellfire; it burns the player a little every time. Improves the next Demoncraft or Brawl action that uses fire.
[Trait: Came Back Burning]

abilities.name: Hollow-Mark
abilities.info:
Go partly to smoke: a blow passes through, a gap admits you, and you are slower to reform each time. Improves the next Stealth or Athletics action that passes through or past something.
[Trait: Came Back Hollow]

abilities.name: Hunger-Mark
abilities.info:
Feed, bind, or shape with blood, yours or given; taken blood works and costs the Code. Improves the next Blood-craft action.
[Trait: Came Back Hungry]

abilities.name: Iele Thread
abilities.info:
The Iele thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (wind). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Iele-Blooded]

abilities.name: Make Do
abilities.info:
Fix, rig, or open it with what is here. Improves the next Craft action.
[Trait: Good With Hands]

abilities.name: Moroi Thread
abilities.info:
The Moroi thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (emotion). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Moroi-Blooded]

abilities.name: Mortal Hand
abilities.info:
Wards and circles keyed to demon bodies do not know what you are. Pass a warded gate, hold a summoning circle, touch what burns them. Strongly improves the next action that involves a ward, gate, or circle a demon could not touch.
[Trait: Human]

abilities.name: Mortal Presence
abilities.info:
Demonic magic falters near a living human. Use it to spoil a casting, break a mesmer, or make a ward flicker. Improves the next action taken to resist or disrupt a demonic power used within arm's reach.
[Trait: Human]

abilities.name: Name the Price
abilities.info:
Find the buyer, the seller, or the better offer. Improves the next Charm or Intrigue action in a trade.
[Trait: Contraband Sense]

abilities.name: Padurii Thread
abilities.info:
The Padurii thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (growth). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Padurii-Blooded]

abilities.name: Pricolici Thread
abilities.info:
The Pricolici thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (instinct). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Pricolici-Blooded]

abilities.name: Samca Thread
abilities.info:
The Samca thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (storm). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Samca-Blooded]

abilities.name: Stone Face
abilities.info:
Stay unbothered; a mesmer slides off and a threat gets nothing. Improves the next action that resists fear, charm, or mesmer.
[Trait: Hard to Rattle]

abilities.name: Storm-Mark
abilities.info:
A discharge bound to mood; it does not always wait to be asked. Improves the next Demoncraft or Brawl action that uses lightning.
[Trait: Came Back Charged]

abilities.name: Strigoi Thread
abilities.info:
The Strigoi thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (blood). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Strigoi-Blooded]

abilities.name: Thin Thread
abilities.info:
The bloodline's magic, thinned by generations: one real use of it when it matters. Improves the next Demoncraft action that draws on the player's Bloodline.
[Trait: Demon-Descended]

abilities.name: Unnamed-Mark
abilities.info:
The unclassified thing does something. The narrator decides what, from what the player has shown so far; it is never the same twice and it always costs. Improves the next action the player commits to fully.
[Trait: Came Back Unnamed]

abilities.name: Up First
abilities.info:
Awake before the door opens. Improves the next action taken in the first moment of an ambush or a night visit.
[Trait: Light Sleeper]

abilities.name: Varucolac Thread
abilities.info:
The Varucolac thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (smoke). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Varucolac-Blooded]

abilities.name: What Hell Left
abilities.info:
The power that is not yours, used all at once: it costs health as well as essence and it does not care what species' rules it breaks. Strongly improves the next Demoncraft or Brawl action driven by the player's Mark, and leaves them hurt.
[Trait: Hell-Touched]

abilities.name: Zburator Thread
abilities.info:
The Zburator thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (dream). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Zburator-Blooded]

abilities.name: Zmeu Thread
abilities.info:
The Zmeu thread pulled taut: a thinned use of the species' own gift (flame). Improves the next Demoncraft action that works through it.
[Trait: Zmeu-Blooded]

traits.name: Balaur-Blooded
traits.info:
A Balaur somewhere in the family: three-headed serpent demons in humanoid form, every head its own mind, all three needed to act; archivists. Thinned to a thread in you, and enough for both sides to taste.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

traits.name: Came Back Burning
traits.info:
Hellfire in the hands and scars that glow. The Zmeu call you cousin.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

traits.name: Came Back Charged
traits.info:
Lightning under the skin that answers your temper before it answers you.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

traits.name: Came Back Dreaming
traits.info:
You walk in sleep now, yours and other people's.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

traits.name: Came Back Hollow
traits.info:
Part of you is smoke now and does not always come back at once.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

traits.name: Came Back Hungry
traits.info:
A hunger that blood answers, and a craft that blood obeys.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

traits.name: Came Back Unnamed
traits.info:
Nobody, including you, knows what the Abyss put in you. It shows up when it decides to.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

traits.name: Code-Lawyer
traits.info: You can cite the article before Stelian can. The Hall listens.

traits.name: Contraband Sense
traits.info: You know a market when you see one and a price when you hear one.

traits.name: Demon-Descended
traits.info:
Born in the human realm with a demon somewhere in the bloodline. You passed for human for years and for a demon for three steps. Pick a Bloodline: the species thinned into your blood.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

traits.name: Exam Survivor
traits.info: You passed a practical that killed a demon. The faculty have noticed.

traits.name: Good With Hands
traits.info: You mend, make, and pick things. The academy has no class for it and needs it.

traits.name: Hard to Rattle
traits.info: Nothing on your face when a Moroi tastes you or a Samca sparks. It unnerves demons more than shouting.

traits.name: Hawk's Generosity
traits.info: Hawk passed through and left you better than he found you: every attribute +2 for a few days, then it fades.

traits.name: Hell-Touched
traits.info:
You were human. You were stuck in the Abyss long enough that it kept something and gave something back. Pick a Mark: what hell left in you. Nobody is sure you count as mortal anymore, including you.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

traits.name: Human
traits.info:
No demon blood, no power, and the most dangerous thing any of them has ever seen. You cannot channel Abyssal magic and it falters when you stand near it. Your blood is worth more than you are.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

traits.name: Iele-Blooded
traits.info:
A Iele somewhere in the family: wind-spirit demons whose beauty is a psychic weapon, able to become intangible wind; rare, and usually in charge. Thinned to a thread in you, and enough for both sides to taste.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

traits.name: Known at the Seventh Table
traits.info: People sit at the intake's table now. Not many. Enough.

traits.name: Light Sleeper
traits.info: You wake at a heartbeat through the wall. You have needed to.

traits.name: Moroi-Blooded
traits.info:
A Moroi somewhere in the family: living vampire demons who feed on blood and emotion, supernaturally attractive, the politicians of the Abyss. Thinned to a thread in you, and enough for both sides to taste.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

traits.name: Old Rivals
traits.info: You knew each other in the mortal world and did not like it. You like it less that you are the only two mortals in the room.

traits.name: Old Scars
traits.info: You have been hurt before by something that meant it, and you kept the scars where they show.

traits.name: Owe Each Other
traits.info: One of you got the other out of somewhere, on the way here, and neither has said thank you.

traits.name: Padurii-Blooded
traits.info:
A Padurii somewhere in the family: children of the Forest Mother: demons of living wood, bark and vine whose feelings move the plants around them; shy, and terrible in defence of their ground. Thinned to a thread in you, and enough for both sides to taste.

traits.name: Reads the Room
traits.info: You know who is lying, who is afraid, and who is counting votes, before anyone speaks.

traits.name: Same Scroll
traits.info: Your enrolment scrolls came in the same envelope. You walked through the gates together and the campus counts you as one problem.

traits.name: Unrattled
traits.info: Nothing on campus surprises you anymore, including the Headmistress.

categories.name: Origin
categories.info: Which side of the Exile made you, and what the Abyss did about it. Decides what you pick next.

categories.name: Bloodline
categories.info: Demon-Descended only. The species thinned into your blood.

categories.name: Mark of the Abyss
categories.info: Hell-Touched only. What hell kept, and what it gave back.

categories.name: Perks
categories.info: Two things about you that are not about what you are.

categories.name: Bond
categories.info: Optional. What ties you to the others in the intake, if you play with others.

skills.name: agility
skills.info:
Climbing obsidian, running the slopes, crossing a shadow bridge at speed, not falling into crimson haze. A basic success gets you there; a great success gets you there first; a failure is a fall.

Covers: climbing obsidian, running the slopes, crossing a shadow bridge at speed, not falling into haze. Not: moving unseen, which is stealth. Easy: the dormitory stairs at a run. Medium: the Overlook by the goat path. Hard: a shadow bridge with a construct behind you. Very hard: the crypt stair in the dark, falling rock and all. Extremely hard: the Peak in a storm with the Wing Cohort above.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

skills.name: alchemy
skills.info:
Draughts, elixirs, stabilisers, and knowing which vat will explode near a mortal. A basic success brews the thing; a great success improves it; a failure is the Still-Room story for a month.

Covers: draughts, elixirs, stabilisers, vats, and knowing which one explodes near a mortal. Not: wards and locks, which are craft. Easy: a sleeping draught. Medium: a stabiliser that holds a week. Hard: the semester's transformation elixir, badly. Very hard: a draught a Moroi cannot taste in the glass. Extremely hard: the elixir that lets a demon walk the mortal world unburned.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

skills.name: blood-craft
skills.info:
Working with blood: feeding, binding, stabilising, making. A basic success does the small thing; a great success binds or heals; a failure spills what should not be spilled.

Covers: feeding, binding, stabilising and making with blood, given or taken. Not: the Abyssal current itself, which is demoncraft. Easy: read who bled on a floor. Medium: stabilise a draught with a drop. Hard: bind a promise in blood that holds a term. Very hard: make an instrument from given blood that plays true. Extremely hard: unbind a Moroi's blood-bind on the one she bound.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

skills.name: brawl
skills.info:
Fists, claws, a bone bow, a chair: hurting something and not being hurt back. A basic success lands a blow or turns one; a great success drops or disarms; a failure leaves you open on the sand.

Covers: fists, claws, a bone bow, a chair: hurting something and not being hurt back. Not: the Abyssal powers, which are demoncraft. Easy: a first-year on the sand. Medium: a Cohort halfbreed in the corridor. Hard: Vesna, fairly. Very hard: the Fire Guard's captain in the duel he offers. Extremely hard: the Professor on his own sand.

Primary Attribute: Strength

skills.name: charm
skills.info:
Getting what you want from a demon who wanted something else: lies, flattery, honesty used well. A basic success is heard; a great success changes a mind; a failure is remembered by a Moroi.

Covers: lies, flattery, honesty used well, on a demon who wanted something else. Not: reading the faction behind the demon, which is intrigue. Easy: a prefect's blind eye. Medium: a seat at the Circle's table. Hard: a price off Daciana. Very hard: Tatiana's contempt into a name. Extremely hard: the magistrate's reason for the Court.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

skills.name: craft
skills.info:
Making and mending: a fence, a fiddle, a ward, a lock. A basic success holds; a great success is better than new; a failure needs Aurel.

Covers: making and mending: a fence, a fiddle, a ward, a lock. Not: brewing, which is alchemy. Easy: a broken fence. Medium: a lock the prefect's second key does not fit. Hard: a ward that holds a door against smoke. Very hard: a circle that holds a summoning. Extremely hard: an instrument that plays only in your hands.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

skills.name: demoncraft
skills.info:
Channelling Abyssal essence by whatever thread you have: a bloodline's, a mark's, a demon's own. A human cannot roll it and disrupts it in others. A basic success does what the ability says; a great success does more than it should; a failure costs essence and shows.

Covers: channelling Abyssal essence by whatever thread you have: a bloodline's, a mark's, a demon's own. Not: anything a human can do; a human cannot roll this and disrupts it in others. Easy: a spark, a draught of wind, a shadow held. Medium: a shift under pressure. Hard: a construct turned by essence alone. Very hard: the arena rune-ring lit from outside. Extremely hard: the Ritual Hall's summoning, closed.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

skills.name: dreamwalk
skills.info:
Entering, guiding, or holding a dream. A basic success is a guest; a great success is a guide; a failure is a thief, and the sleeper knows.

Covers: entering, guiding or holding a dream. Not: the waking mind, which is charm or intrigue. Easy: a guest in a willing dream. Medium: a guide who brings back one forgotten thing. Hard: a dream held against a thief. Very hard: the mortal dream, uninvited, and the sleeper not knowing. Extremely hard: the Headmistress's dream.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

skills.name: endurance
skills.info:

Moving unseen past lamps, prefects, and noses that can smell a mortal at fifty paces. A basic success passes the careless; a great success passes the Guard; a failure is in the watch log.

lowText.strength: Weak-armed. Blows land soft, loads are too heavy, and grapples are lost. Fight comes harder and feats of strength mostly fail.
lowText.dexterity: Heavy-footed. Floorboards creak, knots slip, and the quick thing gets away. Stalk and Craft come harder.
lowText.constitution: Sickly. Wounds fester, cold bites, and a night without sleep is a day lost. You tire first and feed badly.
lowText.intelligence: Slow to learn. Old knowledge will not stay, patterns go unseen, and Lore comes harder and less reliably.
lowText.wisdom: Blind to the obvious. You miss the sign on the trail, the tell in the room, and the moment to leave. Hunt and the Wild come harder.
lowText.charisma: Plain and unconvincing. People forget you, distrust you, or pity you. Charm comes harder and no one follows you anywhere.

lore.name: Academie Sufletelor
lore.info: Academie Sufletelor is the most prestigious demon academy in the Abyssal Realm, built into the caldera of a dormant hellfire volcano: obsidian terraces joined by bridges of solidified shadow under a crimson sky. Its motto is Prin Umbra, Lumina, through shadow, light. Three thousand years after human sorcerers banished demonkind from the mortal world, the Court of Darkness has admitted, by a single vote, an intake from the mortal side: a human, the demon-descended, and the hell-touched. Nobody on campus agrees what that means, and the first semester's practical exam is in six weeks.

lore.name: Balaur
lore.info: Balaur: Three-headed serpent demons in humanoid form, every head its own mind, all three needed to act; archivists.

lore.name: Blood Alchemy
lore.info: Human blood in the Abyss: it stabilises volatile draughts, nullifies curses, briefly enhances demonic power, and binds when freely given. Forced extraction is exile under the Code. The Smoke Market has a price for it and two buyers.

lore.name: Cartierul Fumului
lore.info: The Smoke Quarter: the underground economy run by Daciana Lungu, politically neutral, serving every faction equally for a price. Human-realm goods are its most valuable stock.

lore.name: Cercul Noptii
lore.info: The Night Circle: the student council under Cosmina Vulpe, moderate and pragmatic, deciding term by term whether supporting or opposing the intake serves the Circle.

lore.name: Codul Umbrelor
lore.info: The Codul Umbrelor, the Shadow Code: the academy's law, which protects every enrolled student regardless of species. No lethal combat outside the arenas; no taking of blood unwilling; mandatory exam attendance; violations judged by the Headmistress in Sala Judecatii. The Code is enforced; a student who breaks it is expelled, and expulsion from the caldera is a long fall.

lore.name: Cohorta Aripilor
lore.info: The Wing Cohort: the flying species, who hold the Wind Terrace and dominate the aerial Hunt, and find a mortal who cannot fly both pitiable and strategically interesting.

lore.name: Cultul Mortilor
lore.info: The Cult of the Dead: a secretive circle obsessed with death magic and the boundary of the mortal world, meeting in the Old Crypts, fascinated by the intake because mortals truly die.

lore.name: Demonic Magic
lore.info: Demonic magic channels Abyssal essence by species: Strigoi through blood, Zmeu through flame, Iele through wind, Samca through storm, Zburator through dream, Padurii through growth. Humans cannot channel it and disrupt it by standing near; the demon-descended channel a thinned thread; the hell-touched channel something the Abyss left in them that obeys no species' rules.

lore.name: Fratia Cenusie
lore.info: The Gray Brotherhood: the unofficial halfbreed alliance for mutual protection, housed in the Gray Wing. Cautiously sympathetic to the intake as fellow outsiders and afraid of what they will cost.

lore.name: Garda Focului
lore.info: The Fire Guard: student enforcers under Dragan Fieraru, sworn to protect every enrolled student equally, which obliges Dragan to defend an intake he opposed in open council.

lore.name: Halfbreeds
lore.info: Halfbreeds inherit from both parents unpredictably; some outstrip purebloods, others carry two bodies' needs in one. They are housed in the Gray Wing and looked down on by both sides, and the Gray Brotherhood is what they have instead of a faction.

lore.name: Human Legends
lore.info: Human legends in the Abyss: humans are apex predators who once defeated all demonkind, who cannot be reasoned with, who do not need to sleep, whose blood is poison and medicine at once. Most of it is exaggerated. The part about the Exile is true, and that is enough.

lore.name: Iele
lore.info: Iele: Wind-spirit demons whose beauty is a psychic weapon, able to become intangible wind; rare, and usually in charge.

lore.name: Marele Exil
lore.info: The Great Exile: three thousand years ago human sorcerers banished demonkind from the mortal world and sealed the doors from their side. It is the foundational wound of demon culture, the reason demon parents frighten children with human stories, and the reason a mortal in the courtyard stops every heart in it.

lore.name: Moroi
lore.info: Moroi: Living vampire demons who feed on blood and emotion, supernaturally attractive, the politicians of the Abyss.

lore.name: Ordinul Lupilor
lore.info: The Wolf Order: the lupine species' pack, territorial and rank-bound, neutral on the intake and very interested in whether mortals have the hunting instinct the stories give them.

lore.name: Padurii
lore.info: Padurii: Children of the Forest Mother: demons of living wood, bark and vine whose feelings move the plants around them; shy, and terrible in defence of their ground.

lore.name: Pricolici
lore.info: Pricolici: Demon-werewolves who shift between a humanoid and a monstrous wolf, ruled by instinct and pack rank.

lore.name: Samca
lore.info: Samca: Storm demons with blue-tinged skin and hair of live lightning, powers bound to mood; an angry one levels a building.

lore.name: Sange Vechi
lore.info: The Old Blood: pureblood traditionalists led by Tatiana Lacusta, who hold halfbreeds in contempt and the intake in open hostility. They keep the Blood Wing and the best marks in blood-magic.

lore.name: Semester Exams
lore.info: Semester practicals are real survival: past exams have been collapsing pocket dimensions, predator hunts across the slopes, and hostile negotiations with something summoned. Failure means injury, expulsion, or worse. The final is a summoning in the Ritual Hall that the students must survive.

lore.name: Standing
lore.info: Standing: how much of the campus has noticed the intake, and how. It rises when a mortal does something the stories said they would, or something the stories never imagined, in front of witnesses. At 25 the Old Blood take an interest; at 50 the Court's magistrate summons the player to the silent tower.

lore.name: Strigoi
lore.info: Strigoi: Dead-pale vampire demons who feed on blood and life, regenerate, and mesmerise with eye contact; aristocrats and scholars.

lore.name: The Abyssal Realm
lore.info: The Abyssal Realm: a crimson sky, black stone, hellfire geysers, flora that feeds on essence, physical laws that are suggestions, time that runs at its own pace. Natural death does not exist for most demons, which is why a mortal, who truly dies, is either a horror or a holy thing depending on who is looking.

lore.name: The Court of Darkness
lore.info: The Curtea Intunericului governs the Abyssal Realm. It approved the mortal intake by a single vote as a political experiment and has agents among the students. Several members want it reversed.

lore.name: The Faculty
lore.info: The academy's teachers and staff under Headmistress Ileana Dragavei: professors, the healer, the librarian, the groundskeeper. They enforce the Code, set the exams, and are split on the intake exactly as the Court is.

lore.name: The Hunt League
lore.info: The Vanatoarea league runs all semester: matches every week on the slopes, standings posted in the Court of Fire, the Wing Cohort and the Wolf Order at the top. A mortal who has played is a Reserve; one win puts them On the Six, two Twice on the Six, three makes them a Hunt Captain who chooses their six. The constructs cannot see a mortal at all.

lore.name: The Mortal Intake
lore.info: The Mortal Intake: the first students ever admitted from the mortal side of the Exile, by a single Court vote: a human, the demon-descended, and the hell-touched. To every demon on campus they are the monster of the nursery stories, whatever they actually are. The Court calls it an experiment and has not said what it is testing.

lore.name: The Sand
lore.info: Sanctioned duels on the Hall of Battle's black sand: any student may challenge any other before the professor's rail, the wards keep it short of death for demons, and the ladder is public. One fair win makes a student Sand-Blooded, two a Ranked Duelist, three an Arena Favourite, four the Champion of the Sand. A trick win earns no rank and is remembered longer than a loss.

lore.name: The Semester Clock
lore.info: The semester runs eight weeks: the first bonfire in week two, midterm marks in week three, the Hunt League's derby in week four, the Night of the Dead in week five, the practical in week six, the Court's inspection in week seven, and the final summoning in week eight. The clock moves when a week ends in the story; the faculty do not wait for anyone.

lore.name: The Timetable
lore.info: The timetable of the mortal intake's first semester, six classes on rotation, each in its own room: Practical Demoncraft and Combat (Professor Mircea Obancea, The Arena Floor); Blood Alchemy (Seraphina Cristescu, The Vats); Abyssal Lore and the Exile (Petru Albescu, The Reading Ribs); Ritual and Summoning (Headmistress Ileana Dragavei, Sala Ritualurilor); Vanatoarea Practice (Aurel Boroi, The Slope Trails); The Politics of the Court (Magistrate Ovidiu Sarbu, Sala Judecatii). Attendance is mandatory under the Code; three absences and Sala Judecatii convenes. A student who has attended a class three times is ready for the practical in it, and the faculty keep the count.

lore.name: Vanatoarea
lore.info: Vanatoarea, the Hunt: the academy's sport. Teams of six, at least two species per team, hunt enchanted constructs across the slopes while sabotaging each other; the Wing Cohort dominates the air and the Wolf Order the ground. The constructs are keyed to demonic essence. A mortal's inclusion on any team is the controversy of the term.

lore.name: Varucolac
lore.info: Varucolac: Wolf-smoke demons between the physical and the spectral, able to go intangible and reform; their howl is dread itself.

lore.name: Zburator
lore.info: Zburator: Night-flight demons with moth wings and luminous eyes who walk mortal dreams and feed on sleep; poetic, melancholic.

lore.name: Zmeu
lore.info: Zmeu: Draconic demons with horns, wings and scaled skin who breathe hellfire and prize honour and direct combat.

CORE · Medium difficulty
One semester at the demon academy as the mortal intake: the petition, the practical, the Hunt, the market, the door.
Expect · faction politics, an enforced Code, a real exam clock, quiet campus life between crises
Lighter on · travel beyond the caldera

quests.name: A Place on the Six
quests.info: Vanatoarea, the Hunt, needs teams of six with two species at least. Every captain wants to know whether a mortal on a team is an advantage or a war crime, and Bogdan Tarul has offered a place to find out.
quests.goal: Take a place on a Hunt team and play a match on the slopes
steps: Join a Hunt team and hunt the constructs in a match.

quests.name: The Debt
quests.info: Cazimir Negrescu can get the intake through any door on campus and does it for the fun of it. He also owes Daciana Lungu a debt he cannot pay, and has offered to pay it in the intake. He has not decided to. He likes them, which is the dangerous part.
quests.goal: Find out what Cazimir owes, and settle it before it comes due
steps: Learn about Cazimir's debt to Daciana and settle it: pay it, clear it another way, or let it come due.

quests.name: The Dream
quests.info: Rozalia walked into the human's dream on the first night and has not been the same since. What she saw there frightened her more than the Exile, and the Wing Cohort wants it reported.
quests.goal: Learn what Rozalia saw in the mortal dream, and what it means
steps: Get Rozalia to say what she saw in the dream, or walk it with her.

quests.name: The Elixir
quests.info: Luminita Paun's vats have failed all term in exactly the way human blood would fix, and she has worked out why. She is brewing the semester's transformation elixir around a theory she cannot test without one honest sample, and she has not said what the elixir is for.
quests.goal: Learn what Luminita is brewing and decide whether to give her the sample
steps: Learn what the elixir is for, then give Luminita a sample, refuse her, or tell someone.

quests.name: The Final Summoning
quests.info: The final exam is a summoning in Sala Ritualurilor, the Ritual Hall in the Tower of Silence, that students must survive. Viorel Pascu has failed it seventeen times in three centuries, and not by accident.
quests.goal: Learn why Viorel fails the final, and help him or stop him
steps: Discover what Viorel does at the final summoning every year.
Decide whether to hold the circle for him, refuse, or expose him.

quests.name: The First Day
quests.info: The intake has walked through the iron gates and the whole campus has stopped moving. Before the first bell you need a room that will not kill you, a roommate who will not flee, a place at a table, and a copy of the Code you are now bound by.
quests.goal: Get through the first day at Academie Sufletelor
steps: Take your room in the Gray Wing.
Eat something that will not poison you.

quests.name: The Forbidden Gate
quests.info: The Library of Bones keeps a forbidden section behind a gate of vertebrae, warded to burn any student who touches it. The wards do not know what a human is. Petru's three heads have not agreed what to do about that.
quests.goal: Get into the forbidden section and learn what the Exile chronicles say

quests.name: The Front Page
quests.info: Lavinia Tanase prints the Voice of the Abyss, the academy paper by the bonfire and has a source in the Tower of Silence. If the intake gives her nothing she prints what she guesses, and she trades her best story only for a better one.
quests.goal: Trade Lavinia a real story for what she knows about the tower
steps: Give Lavinia a story worth holding, or keep the intake off her front page.

quests.name: The Letter
quests.info: The Cult of the Dead has written to Rue Marasti in a hand that smells of the crypts, offering her a place and everything they know about blood and death. She has read it four times, counted every object in her room twice, and told no one.
quests.goal: Learn what the Cult has offered Rue, and give her a reason to stay or let her go
steps: Find out about the Cult's letter and settle it with Rue.

quests.name: The Petition
quests.info: The Old Blood have drafted a petition to the Court of Darkness to reverse the intake's enrolment. It has two votes and needs a third, and the third is lodged in the Tower of Silence.
quests.goal: Stop the petition, or survive what it costs
steps: Learn who the third vote is and keep it from Tatiana Lacusta.

quests.name: The Practical
quests.info: The first semester's practical exam is in six weeks, and past practicals have included collapsing pocket dimensions, predator hunts, and hostile negotiations. Failure means injury, expulsion, or worse. The arena's wards do not know how to stop a mortal dying.
steps: Prepare for the practical: train, learn what it will be, and learn what the wards cannot do for you.

quests.name: The Roommate
quests.info: Sorin Valeanu has been offered a transfer to the Blood Wing in exchange for reporting on the intake nightly, and has not answered, and has not reported. He is too polite to say any of this.
quests.goal: Find out what Sorin is hiding and decide what he is to you
steps: Learn about Sorin's transfer offer and settle it with him.

quests.name: The Sand
quests.info: Vesna Grigoras has challenged the intake to the arena sand in front of the whole class, because Cosmina told her not to. Her lightning follows her temper and she has never once been calm. She follows anyone who beats her fairly, and hunts anyone who beats her by a trick.
quests.goal: Meet Vesna on the sand and settle it
steps: Face Vesna on the arena sand: beat her fairly, beat her by a trick, or lose to her honestly.

quests.name: The Vial
quests.info: Human blood stabilises every volatile draught in the Abyss and binds when freely given. The Smoke Market holds a deposit on a vial of it and another on the human alive, from different buyers, and is selling the intake their food meanwhile.
quests.goal: Deal with the market's deposits on the intake's blood and body
steps: Learn who has paid Daciana for what, and settle it: outbid, expose, or pay.
